name: Holy Spirit The Is God
overview: The Scriptures reveal the Holy Spirit as omnipresent, intimately involved in every place and circumstance, as shown in Psalms 139:7-12 where no darkness or distance can separate us from His presence. This underscores the divine nature of the Holy Spirit, affirming His equality with the Father and His eternal, all-encompassing presence. Such truths lay the foundation for understanding the Holy Spirit as God, actively guiding, comforting, and sanctifying the Church.
